payout_quote: Get Up To $300 When You Open A Panacea Checking Account. Open and fund your account to earn $100. Share your referral code. Earn $100 when they open and fund their account. Complete 15 transactions of $10+ within 60 days of opening to earn another $100. Your bonus is deposited at the statement cycle following your 60-day window.
steps: Qualify for Panacea membership: practicing physician/dentist/veterinarian, or med/dental/vet school, residency, or fellowship (friends/family/colleagues with a valid referral code also eligible)
Apply online and open and fund a Panacea Checking Account to earn $100
Complete 15 transactions of $10 or more within 60 days of account opening to earn another $100 (use debit card)
Optionally refer a fellow doctor within 60 days - earn $100 when they open and fund their account (raises total to $300)
Bonus deposited at the statement cycle following the 60-day window
catches: Promo expiration (cited as 3/1/27 by bonus trackers) and early-closure fee details sit in the official page's footnote 5, which did not render in the text fetch - confirm the current promo end date on the live page before acting
Eligibility is narrow: physicians, dentists, veterinarians, students, residents, fellows - or friends/family/colleagues with a valid referral code only
Full $300 requires successfully referring a colleague who opens and funds an account within 60 days; $200 is the self-contained maximum without a referral (open/fund $100 + 15 transactions $100)
15 transactions of $10+ each required within 60 days - real activity threshold
Promotional period reported as 3/1/2026 - 3/1/2027 (via third-party quoting official terms); confirm code/period at application
Doctor of Credit notes publicly posted referral codes may be invalid - use an official personal referral link
$25 early account termination fee if closed within 90 days (per DoC)
biggest_catch: Only doctors/dentists/veterinarians (and trainees, plus referred friends/family) qualify; the full $300 needs a successful referral, and you must make 15 qualifying $10+ transactions in 60 days.
eligibility: Practicing physicians, dentists, veterinarians, med/dental/vet students/residents/fellows; limited access for friends, family, colleagues with a valid referral code.
timing: 15 transactions within 60 days of account opening; referral must open and fund within 60 days of referrer's account opening; bonus paid at the statement cycle following the 60-day window.
